description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'MergedJsonObjectMap' which implements the Map interface to merge two JSON objects ('jsonObject' and 'fallbackObject') and expose them as a single Map view. It provides methods for accessing JSON data with fallback logic, but does not support modification operations, emphasizing immutability.

classes.name: MergedJsonObjectMap
classes.description: An immutable implementation of Map for merging two JSON objects, providing fallback logic when retrieving values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create an instance of MergedJsonObjectMap from either two JSON objects or an existing Map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the merged map.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if both underlying JSON objects are empty.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in either of the underlying JSON objects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key, first from 'jsonObject', then fallback to 'fallbackObject' if not found.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all keys from both JSON objects.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of all values from both JSON objects.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all entries combining both JSON objects.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another MergedJsonObjectMap object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on contained JSON objects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the object, including its internal JSON objects.
